incidents.name: XSD/WETH pool burnpoolXSD reentrancy
incidents.notes: swapXSDForETH() sends ETH with TransferHelper.safeTransferETH() before it updates the pool's accounting, letting the attacker re-enter burnpoolXSD() from the receive hook and drain the pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xfadda925e10d07430f5d7461689fd90d3d81bb48 created 2023-06-24T13:03:45Z by 0x03e33bab8414bdb433e883785f91ede95f0f4dfe, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x506eebd8d6061202a8e8fc600bb3d5d41f475ee1; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 56.9 BNB x $211.832899/BNB at the incident timestamp 1695753432 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $12,053.
